source_record.english: Coveting consists of a wrong (that is, an improper) desire for another's wealth, which leads to a wish that one make it his own. Harmful intent is the desire to hurt another living being, a desire which comes from the attitude of hating him. And mistaken view is the idea that neither virtue nor non-virtue even exists. Next we discuss the literal meaning of the expression "a path of action." 79 Explanation of the Expression "Path of Action"
